<!-- Master Summary plot palette and left-aligned titles as the default Plotly / matplotlib style,
     and the figure, table and caption helpers the report notebooks share. -->

```{python}
#| include: false
import matplotlib as _mpl
import pandas as _pd
import plotly.graph_objects as _go
import plotly.io as _pio
from IPython.display import HTML as _HTML

# Master Summary palette and layout (pal / ttl in _ms_setup.qmd).
_REPORT_PALETTE = ["#2c7fb8", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#1b9e77",
                   "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02", "#a6761d"]
_pio.templates["tcrtoolkit"] = _go.layout.Template(layout=dict(
    font=dict(family='"Source Sans Pro", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif',
              size=13, color="#373a3c"),
    title=dict(x=0, xanchor="left", font=dict(size=16)),
    colorway=_REPORT_PALETTE,
))
_pio.templates.default = "plotly_white+tcrtoolkit"

_mpl.rcParams.update({
    "axes.prop_cycle": _mpl.cycler(color=_REPORT_PALETTE),
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.titlelocation": "left",
    "font.size": 11,
})

# ---- Figure and table numbers ------------------------------------------------
# Called from the captions (`{python} fig_no()`), which Quarto evaluates in document order,
# so the numbers stay consecutive when a section is left out.
_rt_counts = {'fig': 0, 'tab': 0}


def fig_no():
    _rt_counts['fig'] += 1
    return _rt_counts['fig']


def tab_no():
    _rt_counts['tab'] += 1
    return _rt_counts['tab']


def rt_caption(title, text='', kind='Figure'):
    """A numbered caption printed from an `output: asis` cell (for figures drawn conditionally)."""
    n = fig_no() if kind == 'Figure' else tab_no()
    print(f"\n**{kind} {n}. {title}.** {text}\n")


# ---- Colours -----------------------------------------------------------------
def rt_colors(values):
    """One colour per category: the palette plus four extra hues, interpolated when there are
    more categories than colours (state_cols() of the Master Summary)."""
    lv = [str(v) for v in values]
    base = _REPORT_PALETTE + ["#4d4d4d", "#b15928", "#6a3d9a", "#ff7f00"]
    if len(lv) <= len(base):
        return dict(zip(lv, base))
    rgb = [tuple(int(c[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (1, 3, 5)) for c in base]
    out = []
    for k in range(len(lv)):
        t = k * (len(rgb) - 1) / (len(lv) - 1)
        i = min(int(t), len(rgb) - 2)
        f = t - i
        out.append('#%02x%02x%02x' % tuple(round(a + (b - a) * f) for a, b in zip(rgb[i], rgb[i + 1])))
    return dict(zip(lv, out))


# ---- Figures -------------------------------------------------------------------
RT_CONFIG = dict(displaylogo=False, modeBarButtonsToRemove=['select2d', 'lasso2d'],
                 toImageButtonOptions=dict(format='png', scale=2))


def rt_show(fig):
    fig.show(config=RT_CONFIG)
    print("\n")


def rt_show_wide(fig):
    """A figure wider than the page, in a box that scrolls sideways (`output: asis` cells only)."""
    print("\n::: {.fig-scroll}\n")
    fig.show(config=RT_CONFIG)
    print("\n:::\n")


def rt_show_box(fig):
    """A figure outside a tabset, framed like one (`output: asis` cells only)."""
    print("\n::: {.fig-box}\n")
    fig.show(config=RT_CONFIG)
    print("\n:::\n")


def rt_sbar(df, title, xlab, colors=None, cat_order=None, grp_order=None, legend_title='',
            tickformat='.0%', height=None):
    """Stacked horizontal bars in the Master Summary style (sbar() in _ms_setup.qmd): one bar
    per category, the first category on top, hover text on every segment, legend on the right.
    df: cat, grp, val (fractions), hover."""
    d = df.copy()
    d['cat'] = d['cat'].astype(str)
    d['grp'] = d['grp'].astype(str)
    cats = [str(c) for c in cat_order] if cat_order is not None else list(dict.fromkeys(d['cat']))
    grps = [str(g) for g in grp_order] if grp_order is not None else list(dict.fromkeys(d['grp']))
    colors = colors or rt_colors(grps)
    fig = _go.Figure()
    for g in grps:
        s = d[d['grp'] == g]
        if s.empty:
            continue
        fig.add_trace(_go.Bar(x=s['val'], y=s['cat'], orientation='h', name=g,
                              marker_color=colors.get(g), text=s['hover'], textposition='none',
                              hovertemplate='%{text}<extra></extra>'))
    fig.update_layout(barmode='stack', title=dict(text=title, x=0, xanchor='left'),
                      height=height or max(420, 26 * len(cats) + 160),
                      margin=dict(l=140, t=60),
                      xaxis=dict(title=xlab, tickformat=tickformat),
                      yaxis=dict(title='', type='category', categoryorder='array',
                                 categoryarray=cats, autorange='reversed'),
                      legend=dict(orientation='v', x=1.02, y=1, yanchor='top',
                                  title=dict(text=legend_title), traceorder='normal'))
    return fig


# ---- Tables ------------------------------------------------------------------
def rt_table(df, title='', max_height='400px', formatter=None):
    """A table styled like the Master Summary's (light grey header, striped compact rows, text
    left- and numbers right-aligned) in a scrollable box. Returns HTML for display()."""
    if df is None or df.empty:
        print(f"{title}: No data to display.")
        return None
    styles = [
        dict(selector="", props=[("border-collapse", "collapse"), ("width", "100%"),
                                 ("font-size", "0.875rem")]),
        dict(selector="th", props=[("background-color", "#f7f7f8"), ("text-align", "left"),
                                   ("font-weight", "600"), ("padding", "6px 8px"),
                                   ("border-bottom", "2px solid #e1e1e1"),
                                   ("position", "sticky"), ("top", "0")]),
        dict(selector="td", props=[("text-align", "left"), ("padding", "6px 8px"),
                                   ("border-bottom", "1px solid #f0f0f0"), ("white-space", "nowrap")]),
        dict(selector="tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td", props=[("background-color", "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)")]),
        dict(selector="tbody tr:hover td", props=[("background-color", "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)")]),
        dict(selector="caption", props=[("caption-side", "top"), ("font-size", "1.05em"),
                                        ("font-weight", "600"), ("text-align", "left"),
                                        ("color", "#212529"), ("margin-bottom", "8px")]),
    ]
    styler = df.style.set_table_styles(styles).set_caption(title).hide(axis='index')
    # Text left-aligned, numbers right-aligned (!important: the table-wide td rule is more specific).
    num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if _pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c])]
    if num_cols:
        styler = styler.set_properties(subset=num_cols, **{'text-align': 'right !important'})
    # Whole numbers without decimals, other numbers to 4 significant digits, unless given.
    fmt = {}
    for c in df.columns:
        if _pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(df[c]):
            fmt[c] = '{:,.0f}'
        elif _pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(df[c]):
            v = df[c].dropna()
            fmt[c] = '{:,.0f}' if len(v) and (v == v.round()).all() and v.abs().max() >= 1 else '{:.4g}'
    fmt.update(formatter or {})
    if fmt:
        styler = styler.format(fmt, na_rep="NA")
    return _HTML(f'<div style="max-height: {max_height}; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; '
                 f'border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 1rem;">{styler.to_html()}</div>')
```
